premise.premise: A child offers to swap something valuable for something small, because they really want to make a new friend. The other child notices the real reason.

item.title: A Fun Game
item.passage: Tom sat on the grass at school. He saw Lily with a small brown leaf in her hand. Tom gave Lily his red robot because he wanted to play a fun game. Lily looked at the red toy and smiled. Lily sat next to Tom because she wanted to play a game. They played with the robot on the grass. The two children enjoyed their happy day.

questions.stem: What did Lily have in her hand?
options: A small green leaf

A small brown leaf
questions.evidence: He saw Lily with a small brown leaf in her hand.

questions.stem: Why did Tom give his robot to Lily?
options: Because he wanted to show a cool toy

Because he wanted to make a new friend

questions.stem: Why did Lily sit next to Tom?
options: Because she wanted to be his friend
Because she wanted to play a game
Because she wanted to talk to him
